senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be much, many; to grow, increase.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 87b:14">Yoma 87ᵇ</cite> <he>עונותינו רָבוּ וכ׳</he> our sins are too many to be counted.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:15">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> <he>אצא ואהי פרה ורָבֶה וכ׳</he> I may go out (of the ark) and be multiplying and increasing for curse.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:17">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>דם ר׳ שחין ר׳</he> if the blood is allowed to increase (if bleeding is neglected), skin disease will develop; <he>מי רגלים רָּבִין וכ׳</he> if one allows the urine to increase (through neglect) &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:9">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>בעון … צרות רָבוֹת וכ׳</he> for the sin of obscene talk troubles increase, and new evil decrees come &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:8">Num. R. s. 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01598"><he>פָּרָה</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:15">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> <he>הכתב ר׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K01341"><he>כְּתָב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 47b:23">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>משרבו … בדין ר׳ וכ׳</he> when the whisperers in court (secret influences) increased, the anger (of God) against Israel increased.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:9">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>העזות תִּרְבֶּה</he> impudence shall be large.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:8:2">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="A01935"><he>אל״ף</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:17">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (play on <he>בן פרת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:22">Gen. XLIX, 22</cite>) <he>בן פירות רָבִיתָה</he> ‘a child of fruits’ (through interpreting Pharaoh’s dream about the ears of corn) thou didst grow (to high office); <he>בן פרות רביתה יוסף</he> ‘a child of cows’ (through interpreting the dream about cows) thou didst grow; <he>בן פורת</he> (<cite ref="J00219"><he>יוסף</he></cite>) <he>רָבִיתָ יוסף</he> ‘a child of growth’, thou didst grow tall (so as to protect Rachel from Esau’s sight; v.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:16">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>); Yalk. ib. 133 [read:] <he>בן פורת יוסף פָּרִיתָ רבית יוסף</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:10">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> <he>ר׳ בטהורים יותר וכ׳</he> ordered a larger number of the clean animals to be taken into the ark than of the unclean.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 4:12">Tosef. Dem. IV, 12</cite> <he>ר׳ בעיר ולא ר׳ במדינה</he> if one offers a large quantity for sale, while none is offered in the country.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 4:13">Ib. 13</cite> <he>כל שר׳ לו מותר</he> wherever one has a large quantity for sale, it is permitted (to buy of him); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Menachot 89a:6">Men. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ שמן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00094"><he>רְבִיכָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (hermeneutics) to use an additional word for the purpose of intimating something not otherwise included; to argue from an additional word or from a generalization in the Biblical text; to widen the scope of a law; to include. Ib. אם אתה מְרַבֶּה וכ׳ if thou wert to argue an entire day on the intimation of an increase lying in the words bashshemen (Lev. VI, 14; VII, 12), I should not listen to thee; Zeb. 82ᵃ; Nidd. 72ᵇ.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 26a:22">Shebu. 26ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02097"><he>מָעַט</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shevuot 27a:15">Ib. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מדאצטריך או לְרַבּוֹת וכ׳</he> as the word <cite ref="A00517"><he>אוֹ</he></cite> (<cite ref="Leviticus 5:4">Lev. V, 4</cite>) is needed for the inclusion of vows for the benefit of others.
<cite ref="Pesachim 22b:11">Pes. 22ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A03395"><he>אֵת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60b:13">Snh. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>יכול שאני מְרַבֶּה וכ׳</he> you might think that I must include &c.; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 348:4">Yalk. Ex. 348</cite> <he>ר׳ כל וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00704"><he>רִיקֵן</he></cite>.]—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:14">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 38:29">Gen. XXXVIII, 29</cite>) <he>זה רִבָּה על כל הפריצים ממך יעמודו</he> (not <he>יעמוד</he>) this event implies (the prophecy) that all conquerors shall rise from thee (Perez); Yalk. ib. 145.

senses.gloss: to lend or borrow on usury (רִבִּית); to make a profit. Sifra B’har, ch. VI, Par. 5; B. Mets. V, 1 (expl. תַּרְבִּית) המְרַבֶּה בפירות he who makes a profit on lending provisions.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 4:2">Tosef. ib. IV, 2</cite> <he>מְרַבִּין על השכר ואין מרבין וכ׳</he> you may make a profit on renting (lending money to the money-changer merely for exhibition), but you dare not make a profit on a sale (of land as security for a loan).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:2">B. Mets. V, 2</cite> <he>מרבין … ואין מרבין וכ׳</he> you may make a profit by a reduction of rent on account of payment in advance, but you dare not make a profit by increasing the price of an object sold on account of postponed payment; a. e.

senses.gloss: to cause increase; to strengthen; to do much.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17a:17">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02097"><he>מָעַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:17">Ab. I, 17</cite> <he>וכל המַרְבֶּה דברים וכ׳</he> he that talks much brings about sin.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:7">Ib. II, 7</cite> <he>מרבה בשר וכ׳</he> making much flesh (indulging in eating) makes much food for worms; <he>מרבה צדקה וכ׳</he> he that does much charity, does much for peace.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:8">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>מפרין ומרבין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01598"><he>פָּרָה</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 64a:13">Ib. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ת״ח מַרְבִּים וכ׳</he> scholars advance peace in the world; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 11b:5-7">B. Bath. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>בני מבוי … שמרבה עליהן את הדרך</he> the neighbors may prevent him, because he increases the use of the way too much for them (causes many people to step upon their ground); <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 1:4">Tosef. ib. I, 4</cite>; Y. ib. II, 13ᵇ bot. <he>דו יכיל מימר … והן מרבין עלינו וכ׳</he> he may say to him, they go and come, ask for thee and cannot find thee, and thus they use the way too frequently for us.

senses.gloss: to be increased; with בגדים, to be clothed with the larger number of garments designated for the high priest, v. מְרוּבֶּה.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 5a:13">Yoma 5ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ שבעה</he> if he wore the high priestly garments during the entire week of inauguration; <he>נ׳ יום אחד</he> if he wore them only one day.
